g.text: Racehorse Training & Club Management System • Logical Software Architecture & Communication Baseline
• Cloud object & CDN media asset storage (cloudinary-http5:2.4.0)
• Secure upload and retrieval of horse photos, medical exams & care proof
• Digital wallet checkout link creation & QR bank transfer scanning
• Asynchronous payment notification webhooks with cryptographic checksum
• Centralized HTTP REST Client (fetch API + JWT Interceptor)
• Dynamic role-based route guards & session management
• User account lifecycle & dynamic permission matrix
• Stable facility configuration & quarantine capacity rules
• Feed/bedding stock replenishment proposals & club audits
• Hourly racetrack slot reservations & schedule management
• Track lane conflict avoidance & horse readiness validation
• Conditioning plans, performance milestones & trial runs
• Feeding plan execution & photo verification uploads
• Daily automated care & training activity reports
• Digital wallet top-up via PayOS VietQR & boarding fees
Single deployable archive (com.racehorse.*) hosting 10 modular domain packages with in-process eventing
Spring Security: Stateless JWT Authentication & Dynamic Role-Based Access Control (@PreAuthorize)
User authentication, JWT token issuance & verification
Horse master profiles & RFID microchip identification
Track lane conflict prevention algorithm & readiness check
Race event definitions, divisions & lane distribution
Owner entry consent, trial run evaluation & results log
Interactive barn stall map & horse intake staging
Quarantine zone limits (max 4/zone) & stall transfer history
Shift checklists (feeding, turnout, grooming, hoof care)
Nutritional feeding plans & ration formula templates
Feed/bedding inventory stock ledger & replenishment proposals
Owner digital wallet ledger & deposit balance tracking
PayOS checkout session handling & automated fee deductions
Daily cron automation (06:00 AM) for health audits
In-app multi-role priority alerting queue (<30s triage)
Security audit events & SQL exception tracing
Verified by frontend on application initialization
Generates itemized VietQR checkout payment requests
Handles webhook payload signature checksum verification
Spring Data JPA / Hibernate ORM & JdbcTemplate
HikariCP connection pool with statement caching
• Primary relational data store for all club domains
• Centralized schema baseline with strict ACID guarantees
Managed by Spring Data JPA / Hibernate entities
• Horse master records, microchips & 3-gen pedigree tree
• Stalls, facilities, hourly track lanes & race events
• Clinical records, 21-zone injury logs & shift tasks
• Digital wallet balances, deposits & fee ledgers
• Eliminates race conditions in hourly track slot booking
• ACID compliance, foreign key cascades & check rules
• Captures before & after JSON snapshots of critical data
• Audits role permission updates & security assignments
• Digital wallet balance changes & payment transactions
• Medical clearance updates & training lock toggles
• Full referential integrity enforced via foreign keys
• Media files stored externally in Cloudinary (URLs only)
